_comment: Perf baseline. startup + frame sections generated 2026-06-12 on linux-x64 and PRESERVED (their budgets carry deliberate CI-runner headroom; WO-210 owns any ratcheting of them). line section added 2026-07-03 (WO-202) on a quiet linux-x64 dev box; transcript.append_one + transcript.resize_1k added 2026-07-03 (WO-209). Ratchet rule: startup budget = ceil(measured_max × 2); frame p95 = stated 16ms SLO; line budgets set just above measured with 2-4× CI headroom. Regenerate with: bun run perf:baseline (note: a regen on a fast quiet box will ratchet startup/frame down — restore those two sections unless WO-210 intends the tightening).

renderer_load_ms.note: Time to cold-import compositor + buffer + grid from a fresh bun process. Budget = ceil(max × 2), rounded to 50ms. Ratchet: tighten budget when measured_max drops below budget/2.

composite_p95_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p95 over 200 full-repaint frames, 80×24 synthetic content. Budget = stated frame SLO (16ms). Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

composite_p99_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p99 over 200 frames. Budget = ceil(measured × 4), rounded to 10ms. Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

transcript.build_1k_ms.note: transcript Line[] build (1000 mixed msgs), COLD (no per-message cache). Gated on p50. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

transcript.append_one_ms.note: WO-209: append ONE message to a warm 1000-message transcript. The per-message Line[] cache reuses the unchanged 1000 and renders only the new one — the same rebuild that costs ~45ms cold (transcript.build_1k) collapses to <1ms and 96KB/403 objects (vs 71MB/695k). Gated on p50. Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

transcript.resize_1k_ms.note: WO-209: a resize changes render width, which keys every message's cache entry, so it invalidates all 1000 and pays a near-full re-render (expected; a resize legitimately re-wraps every line). Gated on p50 at the same ceiling as build_1k. Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

panel.two_pane_build_ms.note: panel-workspace two-pane frame build. Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

markdown.render_ms.note: markdown render (mixed document). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

codeblock.regex_ms.note: code-block render (regex fallback path). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

codeblock.treesitter_ms.note: code-block render (tree-sitter cache-hit path). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

overlay.open_ms.note: overlay open (help overlay frame build). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.
